end.summary: Reviewed digestive-system parts, including mouth, oesophagus, stomach, small intestine, large intestine and anus.
end.parentNote: Yash practised naming digestive-system parts and explaining that an organ system is a group of organs working together. They briefly mixed up the stomach with the digestive system, then corrected this by identifying the stomach as one organ and the system as a group of organs. They also practised ordering cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism, with further practice needed to state the full sequence consistently. At home, ask Yash to arrange these five terms on cards and give one human and one plant example for each level.
